biotools.summary: CardiacField is a computational echocardiography system that utilizes a 2D probe to estimate left and right ventricular ejection fraction. It reconstructs a 3D cardiac volume from sequential 2D images, offering automated function estimation suitable for non-cardiovascular healthcare practitioners.
